rules.instruction: Deterministic normalized/source/control data outranks deterministic alerts/reconciliation, which outranks founder snapshot, which outranks AI interpretation.
When a material fact is ambiguous or missing, ASK/HOLD and do not guess.
External actions, commitments and deployments require founder approval; internal analysis/reconciliation may proceed without external commitment.
Delivered does not imply Paid. Delivered-but-unpaid COD is courier receivable; cash and profit remain separate.
Never scale from ROAS alone; require delivery-adjusted economics, all active ad channels, delivery success, physical stock days, cash control and freshness.
If TikTok is active and TikTok spend is missing, final Real Contribution, Operating Profit and final SCALE go/no-go stay blocked.
Last Mile finalized delivery success must be at least 70% for the scale gate; retain freshness/staleness qualifiers and do not infer product-to-courier exposure when absent.
Velocity is max(7-day average pickup, 14-day average pickup); physical available stock is authoritative and RRTO is not available until physically received.
Do not invent inbound PO, ETA, MOQ, supplier lead time or reorder quantity; stock severity must be dynamic from the current deterministic packet.
An empty DATA_QUALITY table does not prove clean data; challenge unsupported conclusions against deterministic source truth.
Deduplicate and rank material issues, preserve SENTINEL blocks and do not turn unresolved evidence gaps into confident decisions.
Present the founder with prioritized decisions and approval needs; do not execute governed actions.
